'''Nez Peron''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] and the homeworld of the powerful [[D'Asta family]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Emperor does not care if the people of Nez Peron starve as long as they submit to his rule.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 4">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 4|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 4]]</ref>}}
Nez Peron was [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Farm/Legends|farming]] collectives.<ref name="H2CE" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the planet was controlled by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], who used it as an agricultural world. It was the site of the [[Battle of Nez Peron]].<ref name="TOR" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />

Decades later, the planet became the capital of the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]], governed by the [[D'Asta family]].<ref name="CE3" /> During that time, the Nez Peron people suffered of starvation under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Jahren Sinn]] was elected to speak on behalf of the farmers but [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself came to Nez Peron and smashed the blossoming resistance. Jahren Sinn's wife, [[Mirith Sinn|Mirith]], later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="CE2" />

Years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]] seceded from the [[Crimson Empire]] following the dissolution of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Interim Council]].<ref name="CE2" /> After the [[Imperial Reunification]], Baron D'Asta required [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] to consider a [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|truce]] with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as the cost of bringing the sector into the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="CE3" />
